question: {Simplify: } 3( ((4)/(3))x² - 25x + 12 ) - 4( x² + 7x - 18 ).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiply the first term: 3 × (4/3)x² = 4x².

Multiply the second term: −4 × x² = −4x².

Notice the **x² terms cancel out** (4x² − 4x² = 0).

Calculate remaining constant: (3 × 12) − (4 × −18) = 36 + 72 = 108.

Check linear terms: (3 × −25x) − (4 × 7x) = −75x − 28x = −103x.

**∴ The correct answer is −103x + 108.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 3((4/3)x² − 25x + 12) − 4(x² + 7x − 18)

**Formula Used:** **Distributive Property** of multiplication over addition/subtraction: a(b + c) = ab + ac.

⇒ Open the first bracket: 3 × (4/3)x² − 3 × 25x + 3 × 12

⇒ 4x² − 75x + 36

⇒ Open the second bracket: −4 × x² − 4 × 7x − 4 × (−18)

⇒ −4x² − 28x + 72

⇒ Combine all terms: (4x² − 4x²) + (−75x − 28x) + (36 + 72)

⇒ 0 − 103x + 108

⇒ −103x + 108

**∴ The correct answer is −103x + 108.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Always solve **Brackets** first, then **Orders**, followed by **Division**, **Multiplication**, **Addition**, and **Subtraction**.

Combining Like Terms

Only terms with the same **variable** and **exponent** (like x² and x²) can be added or subtracted together.

Sign Multiplication

Remember that a **negative** multiplied by a **negative** results in a **positive** value (− × − = +).</p
